item: OSM: a stored summary of the current places (brands, contact channels, freshness, geography), built when a cut finishes or a daily update ends, read instead of four aggregations
key_paths: src/osm/places_summary.py; src/osm/profile.py; src/osm/geography.py; src/osm/lane_models.py; src/osm/ingest.py; src/osm/apply.py; src/api/osm_lane.py; src/static/app-map.js; tests/test_osm_places_summary.py
summary: Before: the brands, contact-channels, freshness and geography readers each aggregated osm_objects on every request (on a 2.0M-place lane 21.5 s for the four reads of one country). After: four additive lane tables (a header keyed by the country's finished_at, diff_sequence and a rule digest, plus counts, every distinct value and a by-day histogram of the last edit) are built in one pass (9.1 s on 2.0M places) at the end of a cut and once per update run, and read instead; the same four reads take 10.7 s, and the part that was counted from the places drops to milliseconds (what remains is the history and tag-change reads, which are other sources). One function defines each part, so stored equals computed on all four surfaces at several limits (test and bench, identical JSON). A stale or missing summary is never served: the page says computed, why, and asks once for a build (POST /api/osm/countries/{code}/places-summary; a GET never writes). No new strings, no new outbound traffic.
